submission.natural_language_explanation: The pole fires on the token itself when that token's surface carries an English -s/-es inflection: on the -s plural of a count noun (' keys', ' types', ' values', ' bases', ' carrots', ' fields', ' columns') and on the 3sg-singular -s of a verb (' logs', ' reads', ' makes'), with a possessive 's and a following plural-agreeing ' are' only weakly (~0.3-0.6). It is near zero on singular forms, on plurals that carry no -s (' children', ' people', ' data'), and on s-final stems whose -s is lexical rather than inflectional (' status', ' basis', ' this', ' was', ' various', ' series'), while non-English or mid-word pieces ending in -es/-ers ('ges', 'ations') do fire, so the detector keys on the token's surface ending rather than on syntax.

rival_explanations: The pole is a bare orthographic detector of a token ending in the letter s, so it should fire just as strongly on 'status', 'basis', 'this', 'was', 'https', 'various' and 'physics' as it does on plural nouns.

The pole encodes plural number as a concept, so it should fire as strongly on plurals that carry no -s ('children', 'people', 'mice', 'data') as it does on ' keys' or ' types', and it should not fire on 3sg-singular verb forms whose subject is singular.

Η Νέα Γαλλία (γαλλικά: Nouvelle-France) είναι η περιοχή που αποικήθηκε από τη Γαλλία στη Βόρεια Αμερική, κατά τη διάρκεια μίας περιόδου που ξεκίνησε με την ανακάλυψη του Αγίου Λαυρεντίου από τον Ζακ Καρτιέ το 1534 και ολοκληρώθηκε με την εκχώρηση της Νέας Γαλλίας στην Ισπανία και τη Μεγάλη Βρετανία, το 1763. Στην κορύφωσή της ακμής της, το 1712, η Νέα Γαλλία, επίσης αποκαλούμενη και ως η Γαλλική Βορειοαμερικανική Αυτοκρατορία ή Βασιλική Νέα Γαλλία, επεκτάθηκε από την ανατολική ακτή της Νέα Γης και Λαμπραντόρ μέχρι και τα Βραχώδη Όρη και από τον Κόλπο Χάντσον μέχρι τον Κόλπο του Μεξικού.

Η περιοχή κατόπιν διαιρέθηκε σε πέντε αποικίες: τον Καναδά, την Ακαδία, τον Κόλπο Χάντσον, τη Νέα Γη και τη Λουιζιάνα. Η Συνθήκη της Ουτρέχτης οδήγησε στην εγκατάλειψη των γαλλικών διεκδικήσεων στην κεντρική περιοχή της Ακαδίας, τον Κόλπο Χάντσον και τη Νέα Γη, καθώς και στην ίδρυση αποικίας στο Κέιπ Μπρετόν.

Τον 16ο αιώνα, οι περιοχές της Νέας Γαλλίας χρησιμοποιούνταν κυρίως για την εκμετάλλευση των άφθονων φυσικών πόρων, όπως τα γουναρικά, μέσω του εμπορίου με τους ιθαγενείς. Κατά τον 17ο αιώνα άρχισε η άνοδος επιτυχημένων οικισμών στην Ακαδία και το Κεμπέκ. Το 1765 ο πληθυσμός της νέας επαρχίας του Κεμπέκ είχε περίπου 70.000 κατοίκους.

Οι Βρετανοί απέλασαν τους Ακάδιους στη Μεγάλη Αναστάτωση, από το 1755 έως το 1764. Από το 2003, η ημέρα μνήμης για την απέλαση των Ακάδιων είναι η 28η Ιουλίου. Οι απόγονοί τους είναι διασκορπισμένοι στις παραθαλάσσιες επαρχίες του Καναδά, στο Μέιν και στη Λουιζιάνα. Υπάρχουν μικροί πληθυσμοί Ακάδιων στο Σετικάν της Νέας Σκωτίας και στις νήσους Μαγκνταλέν. Κάποιοι μετανάστευσαν στη Γαλλία.

Information is one of the most valuable assets of an organisation. Inappropriate handling of information or the release of confidential information harms the reputation of an organisation and can even lead to claims for damages or legal action. Apart from external threats, such as viruses, spyware or hacking, internal risks of incorrect and incomplete handling of data are crucial.
Every organisation, big or small, benefits from proper protection and correct management of information and information systems. Setting up an Information Security Management System (ISMS) is therefore a precondition for achieving accuracy, completeness, availability and confidentiality of company information. The ISO/IEC 27001 can be used as a basis for this purpose.
The most recent version of ISO/IEC 27001 was published in 2013 and ISO/IEC 27004 in 2016. It is also available in a Dutch & French version. Its structure was entirely revised according to the new High Level Structure (HLS), which matches the new structure of the 2015 editions of ISO 9001 and ISO 14001.
The standard ISO/IEC 27001 provides a framework for defining, implementing, executing, monitoring and improving information security within an organisation. Other standards from the ISO/IEC 27000 family contain more detailed guidelines for risk management or control measures.
Proper protection of proprietary information.
Managing ICT risks and thereby avoiding reputation damage, claims or legal action.
Proper information security creates trust with shareholders and stakeholders.
Certification to ISO/IEC 27001 increases the market value of the organisation if information processing is its core business.
In certain sectors security is a basic requirement, especially if sensitive information is processed.

A farmer described the damage that winter had done to the roof, the barn, and the fence along the road. The treasurer read a letter from the regional office about the status of the grant, and the clerk wrote every word in the minute book. One teacher asked whether the school could borrow the bus for a trip to the campus, but the chair said that the request would need approval from the county. The gardener reported that the soil near the river had frozen, and that the tomato in the greenhouse had lost its leaf. A neighbor told the group about a fox that had taken a hen from the yard. The farmer who owned the field beside the bridge offered to lend a cart for the stone. The clerk noted the offer, and the meeting closed with a short prayer. A child carried a bucket of water from the well, and a dog slept in the shade of the wall. The sky stayed gray, and the air carried the smell of smoke from the chimney. The chair shook the hand of every farmer and thanked the whole group for the work they had done. The clock in the tower struck noon, and a pigeon rose from the roof in a gray cloud.

The surveys begin at dawn, when the insects are still slow and the light falls through the branches. In summer, the meadows dry out, and the grasses turn brown. Dragonflies hover over the ponds, while ducks lead their chicks through the lily pads. Visitors follow the paths that circle the lakes, and volunteers repair the fences and clear the trails. The wardens post notices about the nesting areas, and the rangers check the gates each evening. In autumn, the leaves change color, and the birds gather in large flocks before they leave for warmer regions. The water levels rise again after the rains, and the channels carry sediment down to the delta. Winter brings frost and snow; the ponds freeze, and the tracks of foxes and deer appear on the ice. The staff keep records of every change, and the scientists compare the samples they collect with the data from earlier years. The reserve protects a fragile habitat, and the local communities support the projects that keep the wetlands healthy. School groups come for tours, and the guides explain the cycles that shape the marsh. The seasons pass, the rivers keep moving, and the animals return each year to the places where they were born. Biologists tag the young fish and weigh the frogs they catch in the traps. Artists sketch the clouds and the shadows on the water, and photographers wait for the light to change. The visitor center displays maps, photographs, and models of the watershed, and the staff answer questions about the plants and the animals that live there. At dusk, the bats come out over the water, and the owls call from the trees. In winter, the wardens lead snowshoe tours along the frozen channels, and the visitors watch the tracks of the otters and the deer. The center also runs programs for the schools, and the teachers bring the students to the ponds in the spring. Donations from the members support the repairs, and the volunteers plant the seedlings along the banks. The rivers and the wetlands form a single system, and the seasons connect the water, the soil, and the animals that depend on the marsh.

readings.explanation: The pole fires on the token itself when that token's surface carries an English -s/-es inflection: on the -s plural of a count noun (' keys', ' types', ' values', ' bases', ' carrots', ' fields', ' columns') and on the 3sg-singular -s of a verb (' logs', ' reads', ' makes'), with a possessive 's and a following plural-agreeing ' are' only weakly (~0.3-0.6). It is near zero on singular forms, on plurals that carry no -s (' children', ' people', ' data'), and on s-final stems whose -s is lexical rather than inflectional (' status', ' basis', ' this', ' was', ' various', ' series'), while non-English or mid-word pieces ending in -es/-ers ('ges', 'ations') do fire, so the detector keys on the token's surface ending rather than on syntax.

The pole is a bare orthographic detector of a token ending in the letter s, so it should fire just as strongly on 'status', 'basis', 'this', 'was', 'https', 'various' and 'physics' as it does on plural nouns.

The pole encodes plural number as a concept, so it should fire as strongly on plurals that carry no -s ('children', 'people', 'mice', 'data') as it does on ' keys' or ' types', and it should not fire on 3sg-singular verb forms whose subject is singular.
